beats.text: In Chad, 96.2% of businesses lose power. In Qatar, the figure is 0%.

Qatar is the world's lowest. 0% of firms there experienced power outages.
Saudi Arabia has 0.7%, Kuwait has 3.5%, and China has 3.7%.
